rows.jyutping: je5 saang1 dung6 mat6 gun1 soeng2 zi1 leoi5
rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a trip to see or photograph wild animals in their natural habitat.

example.english: We went on a safari and photographed lots of elephants.
example.traditional: 我哋去咗一次野生動物觀賞之旅，影到好多大象。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 zo2 jat1 ci3 je5 saang1 dung6 mat6 gun1 soeng2 zi1 leoi5 jing2 dou2 hou2 do1 daai6 zoeng6

rows.note: Use this when the safari is focused on hunting, rather than for an ordinary wildlife-viewing trip.

example.english: This safari is specifically for hunting big game.
example.traditional: 呢次狩獵之旅專門獵大型野獸。
example.jyutping: ni1 ci3 sau3 lip6 zi1 leoi5 zyun1 mun4 lip6 daai6 jing4 je5 sau3
